Name: Sandy Revised
Author: stylbash
Description: I wanted a portrait for Sandy that would match some of the other portrait mods I have for my game, and since she's behind a pretty big gate in the game, she's typically the last to get redone, so I made my own. I got rid of her tentacles since they never really made sense to me, gave her a more prominent nose, and made her hair more hairlike. This only changes her portraits, not her sprites.

Downloads.Description: Just unzip and drop in your Content folder
